findings.finding: The compiled-context condition produced a REJECTED outcome on E2 carrying 1 measured regression(s). The work satisfied its stated objective and still broke behaviour, so the defect is in what the condition FAILED TO PRESERVE, not in what it failed to do.
findings.proposed_change: preserve and surface the behavioural dependencies of values the change touches, so a locally correct fix cannot be silently globally wrong
findings.revalidation: regression fixture reproducing this failure SHAPE (not a re-run of the frozen task)

findings.finding: The compiled-context condition starts with 113.8x the context bytes of its counterpart (median 133034 vs 1169 B) and still spends MORE uncached tokens (median -23.7% relative). Front-loaded context is not paying for the exploration it was meant to replace.
evidence: median starting context: 133034 B vs 1169 B
median uncached delta for the heavier condition: -23.7%
findings.proposed_change: move bulk that is not load-bearing for the worker out of the starting payload and behind a retrievable handle, preserving auditability outside the prompt
findings.revalidation: deterministic byte comparison on representative fixtures, before/after

findings.finding: 10 admitted measurements from 14 executions (71%). A harness that loses 4 in 14 is not yet safe to run unattended, and the loss rate is a property of the instrument rather than of the thesis.
evidence: E1 attempt 1: arm B never started - prompt exceeded MAX_ARG_STRLEN (131072 B); no treatment delivered
E4 attempt 1: arm A truncated at the 1800 s ceiling (aborted_tools, is_error true) under CPU contention introduced by concurrent execution
E5 attempt 1: arm A parked on a background monitor and performed no work (0 files) in headless -p, which has nothing that can wake it
E5 attempt 2: arm B terminated aborted_streaming (is_error true) mid-tool-use at 436 s; work product complete but elapsed and token totals are lower bounds
findings.proposed_change: harden the demonstrated runner faults only; no product redesign under harness work
findings.revalidation: the same fault classes exercised as fixtures

findings.finding: The per-task effect changes sign across the set: 2 flip(s), spread 287 percentage points (best +59.2%, worst -227.5%). UNIVERSAL application is therefore unsupported by this evidence. The mechanism is not uniformly wrong; it is unrouted.
findings.proposed_change: replace universal application with a deterministic pre-task eligibility decision, using signals available BEFORE execution, with an explicit fallback
findings.revalidation: deterministic decision fixtures covering the favourable, unfavourable and unmeasurable shapes

findings.finding: No registered gate was met in either direction. The measured effect is directional at best, and no claim of a decisive advantage is supported by this run.
findings.proposed_change: none — record the null and do not re-describe a directional result as a decisive one

authority_note: `execute` means ELIGIBLE TO BECOME A BOUNDED PACKET, never 'already done'. Nothing here holds authority and nothing here is irreversible. Anything above bounded_internal_product_change is queued for a human.
generality_note: These rules were authored by an agent that had already read the outcome they were first tested against. Every rule is a general predicate over the artifact schema and none names an experiment, task, component or constant drawn from it — but a rule set validated only on its inspiring experiment has NOT been shown to generalise.
